# liveview-realtime-dashboard

> Real-time dashboard hub that folds metric updates into rolling bucketed windows and sends each subscriber one coalesced frame per tick, with acknowledgement-based flow control Hex package `trysac_liveview_realtime_dashboard`, module `Trysac.LiveviewRealtimeDashboard`, MIT licensed, Elixir
> >= 1.20 on Erlang/OTP 29, standard library only.
